Factions.Name: Galactic Republic
Factions.Description: Stand with the Republic. Defend a civilization built on freedom, diplomacy, and the ideals of the Jedi Order.

Factions.Name: Sith Empire
Factions.Description: Serve the Empire. Pursue power and order alongside the Sith, Imperial Intelligence, and the galaxy’s most formidable hunters.

Classes.Name: Sith Warrior
Classes.Description: A relentless champion of the dark side. The Warrior dominates the front line through strength and lightsaber mastery.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Juggernaut
AdvancedClasses.Description: A single lightsaber and heavy armor turn the Warrior into an unyielding force.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Marauder
AdvancedClasses.Description: Twin lightsabers and aggressive assaults overwhelm opponents.

Classes.Name: Sith Inquisitor
Classes.Description: Ambition and forbidden knowledge fuel the Inquisitor. Manipulate the Force, channel lightning, and pursue the mysteries of the Sith.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Sorcerer
AdvancedClasses.Description: Command Force lightning from range. The existing Survivors combat kit is available for future integration.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Assassin
AdvancedClasses.Description: A double-bladed lightsaber, stealth, and dark-side techniques define the Assassin.

Classes.Name: Imperial Agent
Classes.Description: The Empire’s unseen operative. Precision marksmanship, advanced technology, and deception serve Imperial Intelligence.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Sniper
AdvancedClasses.Description: Strike from cover with a sniper rifle and carefully placed long-range shots.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Operative
AdvancedClasses.Description: Use concealment, a vibroknife, and field medicine at close quarters.

Classes.Name: Bounty Hunter
Classes.Description: A resourceful professional who tracks dangerous targets. Armor, blasters, and specialized gadgets bring every contract within reach.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Mercenary
AdvancedClasses.Description: Twin blasters, missiles, and support technology provide ranged firepower.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Powertech
AdvancedClasses.Description: Heavy armor, a flamethrower, and close-range tools keep the pressure on.

Classes.Name: Jedi Knight
Classes.Description: A defender of the Republic and a master of lightsaber combat. Courage and disciplined use of the Force guide the Knight.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Guardian
AdvancedClasses.Description: A single lightsaber and protective techniques defend allies on the front line.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Sentinel
AdvancedClasses.Description: Two lightsabers deliver a swift, sustained offensive.

Classes.Name: Jedi Consular
Classes.Description: A scholar and diplomat guided by the Force. The Consular protects the Republic through wisdom, insight, and powerful Force techniques.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Sage
AdvancedClasses.Description: Channel the Force at range to defend, heal, and project telekinetic power.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Shadow
AdvancedClasses.Description: Combine stealth, a double-bladed lightsaber, and precise Force attacks.

Classes.Name: Smuggler
Classes.Description: Quick thinking and a faster blaster keep the Smuggler alive. Luck, cover, and dirty tricks can turn any confrontation.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Gunslinger
AdvancedClasses.Description: Dual blasters and cover deliver precise ranged attacks.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Scoundrel
AdvancedClasses.Description: A scattergun, stealth, and improvised medicine reward close-range ingenuity.

Classes.Name: Trooper
Classes.Description: An elite Republic soldier. Military training, heavy weapons, and advanced armor face the Empire head-on.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Commando
AdvancedClasses.Description: An assault cannon and battlefield support bring heavy ranged power.

AdvancedClasses.Name: Vanguard
AdvancedClasses.Description: A blaster rifle and defensive technology lead the assault at close range.

Maps.Name: Korriban
Maps.Description: Ancient tombs and red sands beneath the Sith Academy. The existing Survivors arena is available for future integration.

Maps.Name: Tython
Maps.Description: Forested birthplace of the Jedi Order. Environment and gameplay are planned.

Maps.Name: Dromund Kaas
Maps.Description: Storm-wreathed capital of the Sith Empire. Environment and gameplay are planned.

Maps.Name: Coruscant
Maps.Description: The vast city-world at the heart of the Republic. Environment and gameplay are planned.

Maps.Name: Hutta
Maps.Description: Industrial swamps and Hutt domains. Environment and gameplay are planned.

Maps.Name: Ord Mantell
Maps.Description: A contested world of smugglers and soldiers. Environment and gameplay are planned.
